caseName: Tuscan Dairy Farms, Inc. v. Barber
caseNameFull: Tuscan Dairy Farms, Inc. v. Barber, Commissioner of Agriculture and Markets of New York

opinions.text: Appeal from Ct. App. N. Y. Motion of The Great Atlantic & Pacific Tea Co., Inc., for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Appeal dismissed for want of substantial federal question. Mr. Justice Powell and Mr. Justice Stevens would note probable jurisdiction and set case for oral argument.
